A Day at the General Assembly

Day nine of ten. A draft resolution full of brackets, a deal in the corridor, a minister on the phone and a vote on the big board. Six parts: listen, follow the documents, answer the questions, and use the transcript only at the end.

6 parts About 6 min 20 questions British & American English

2Answer the questions. Use the colored lines on the bar to replay any sentence.
